# proxmox_node_hardware_pci (Data Source)

Lists the PCI devices of one node from `/nodes/{node}/hardware/pci`, sorted by address. Use `id` plus `vendor`/`device` for `proxmox_cluster_mapping_pci` entries.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_hardware_pci" "node1" {
  node = "pve-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Read-Only

- `devices` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `class` (String)
- `device` (String)
- `device_name` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `iommugroup` (Number)
- `mdev` (Boolean) Whether the device can create mediated devices.
- `subsystem_device` (String)
- `subsystem_device_name` (String)
- `subsystem_vendor` (String)
- `subsystem_vendor_name` (String)
- `vendor` (String)
- `vendor_name` (String)
